headline_html:
1.5.1 — Search score ranges

Core, PyPI, and npm logosdb at 1.5.1. SearchHit.score depends on the distance metric (#142). Cosine is cosine similarity from -1 to 1. Inner product is the raw dot product and can fall outside 0 to 1. L2 is 1 / (1 + distance), in (0, 1], higher when the vectors are closer. No API or scoring change.
